decisions.reason: The source clarifies the separate full-length adaptation as 102 comic pages and identifies materials for reviewing that work; it does not change the completed 18-page sample deliverable.

Selecting materials to review for the full-length adaptation neither changes the creative discretion previously granted specifically for the sample nor extends that discretion to the full-length work.
The full-length page-count and source-material clarification does not alter the sample's panel-based script format or its dialogue-balloon positioning rule.
